title: Context menu
description: The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the area has focus.
when: Power-user shortcuts on canvases, file grids and rows, when the same actions also exist in a visible Menu or toolbar.

instead.need: The only way to reach an action

a11y: The area is focusable; Menu key / Shift+F10 open the menu, which behaves like Menu (arrows, Escape returns focus).
